items.title: Return accident questionnaire
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns den ausgefüllten Fragebogen innerhalb von 10 Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: Period is stated as 10 Arbeitstage (Mon-Fri, excluding public holidays) counted from the letter's date (Briefdatum) of 2026-05-06, not from delivery. Starting the count the day after 2026-05-06 and counting only Monday-Friday business days while skipping public holidays (Christi Himmelfahrt, 2026-05-14, in NW): 2026-05-07 (1), 08 (2), 11 (3), 12 (4), 13 (5), 15 (6), 18 (7), 19 (8), 20 (9), 21 (10). The 10th business day is Thursday, 2026-05-21, which is the deadline for the questionnaire to reach the insurer.

warnings: The letter counts the 10 working days from the letter's printed date rather than from actual receipt; if the letter arrived later, effectively less time remains to respond, so check the postmark/arrival date.

No specific Land was named for the public holiday calculation, so NW (the recipient's home Land) was used as instructed; if the insurer's claims office sits elsewhere, the deadline could shift by a day or two.
